_note: General guidance per industry on needs the 13 district factors do not measure. Not district data: written from common site-selection practice (2026-10-04), shown as 'Also check (not in our data)'. Each item: need, why, step (a plain next step).

preset:automobile.need: Tier-1 and tier-2 parts suppliers within a day's drive
preset:automobile.why: Car and two-wheeler plants run on just-in-time parts deliveries.
preset:automobile.step: List the auto component clusters (Pune–Chakan, Aurangabad) you would buy from and time the drive.

preset:automobile.need: Large flat plot with room to expand
preset:automobile.why: Assembly lines, test tracks and vendor parks need space that grows with volume.
preset:automobile.step: Ask MIDC for plots of the size you need and whether adjoining land can be reserved.

preset:automobile.why: Car carriers need wide roads and turning space from the gate to the highway.
preset:automobile.step: Drive the route from the plot to the highway in a large vehicle.

preset:automobile.why: Shop floors depend on fitters, welders and machine operators.
preset:automobile.step: Meet the nearest ITIs about apprentice batches.

preset:automobile.why: Paint shops need consent from the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB).
preset:automobile.step: Ask MPCB which category your plant falls in and how long consent takes.

preset:electronics.why: Chip and circuit-board making uses very clean water; ordinary supply must be treated on site.
preset:electronics.step: Get a quote for an on-site water purification plant sized to your process.

preset:electronics.why: Even short dips or spikes can ruin a batch, so stable voltage and backup power matter more than hours of supply.
preset:electronics.step: Ask MSEDCL about dedicated feeders and budget for UPS and generator backup.

preset:electronics.why: Components and finished electronics are light and valuable, so they often fly.
preset:electronics.step: Check the drive time to Pune, Mumbai or Nagpur cargo terminals.

preset:electronics.why: Clean rooms and static-safe floors add a lot to construction cost and time.
preset:electronics.step: Get a builder's estimate for the clean-room class you need.

preset:electronics.why: Etching chemicals and electronic scrap need MPCB permission and authorised disposal.
preset:electronics.step: Ask MPCB about consent and find an authorised e-waste recycler nearby.

preset:general_manufacturing.why: Machining, tooling and repair services keep downtime low.
preset:general_manufacturing.step: Visit the local industrial estate and list machine shops you could use.

preset:general_manufacturing.why: Disputed titles and slow building approvals delay projects for months.
preset:general_manufacturing.step: Have a lawyer check the title and ask the planning office about approval times.

preset:general_manufacturing.why: Steel, plastics or other inputs are cheaper when bought nearby.
preset:general_manufacturing.step: Get quotes from suppliers in the district and from the nearest big city.

preset:general_manufacturing.why: Factories need a licence and fire and safety approvals before starting.
preset:general_manufacturing.step: Ask the District Industries Centre (DIC) for the approval checklist.

preset:textile.why: Spinning and weaving units depend on steady cotton or yarn prices and supply.
preset:textile.step: Talk to local ginning units and yarn traders about prices through the year.

preset:textile.why: Dyeing and processing need a common or own effluent treatment plant and MPCB consent.
preset:textile.step: Ask whether a textile park with a common effluent plant is nearby.

preset:textile.why: Garment and weaving units employ many machine operators, often women.
preset:textile.step: Ask the local employment office and garment units about wages and worker availability.

preset:textile.why: State textile policy offers extra support in some talukas and parks.
preset:textile.step: Check the Maharashtra textile policy for your taluka's category.

preset:sugar_ethanol.need: Assured cane area and crushing licence
preset:sugar_ethanol.why: Sugar mills need enough cane within a short haul and follow distance rules between mills.
preset:sugar_ethanol.step: Ask the Sugar Commissioner's office about cane availability and licence rules for the area.

preset:sugar_ethanol.why: Mills and distilleries use a lot of water during the crushing months.
preset:sugar_ethanol.step: Ask the irrigation department about water allocation for industry.

preset:sugar_ethanol.why: Ethanol is sold mainly to oil marketing companies under blending contracts.
preset:sugar_ethanol.step: Check current oil company tenders and prices for ethanol.

preset:sugar_ethanol.why: Spent wash needs zero-liquid-discharge treatment and MPCB consent.
preset:sugar_ethanol.step: Get a quote for effluent treatment and ask MPCB about conditions.

preset:dairy.why: A dairy depends on daily collection from many farmers.
preset:dairy.step: Talk to local milk co-operatives and collection centres about supply and price.

preset:dairy.why: Milk must be chilled within hours of milking.
preset:dairy.step: Plan chilling centres along your collection routes.

preset:dairy.why: Milk products need refrigerated trucks to reach buyers fresh.
preset:dairy.step: Get quotes from refrigerated transporters to your main markets.

preset:dairy.why: Food safety licensing and quality testing are required for dairy products.
preset:dairy.step: Apply for an FSSAI licence and find a nearby food testing lab.

preset:food_beverages.why: Every packaged food unit needs a food safety licence, and buyers often ask for audits.
preset:food_beverages.step: Apply for an FSSAI licence early; it is needed before selling.

preset:food_beverages.why: Fresh inputs and finished products often need cold storage and good packaging nearby.
preset:food_beverages.step: List cold stores and packaging suppliers within an hour's drive.

preset:food_beverages.why: Packaged food sells mainly in cities, so delivery time and cost matter.
preset:food_beverages.step: Work out the trucking time and cost to Mumbai, Pune or your main market.

preset:food_beverages.why: Mega food parks and central and state schemes can cut setup cost.
preset:food_beverages.step: Check for a food park nearby and the PM Formalisation of Micro Food Enterprises scheme if you are small.

preset:agro_cold.why: Processing and storage depend on buying produce from nearby markets and farmers.
preset:agro_cold.step: Visit the local APMC market and farmer producer companies.

preset:agro_cold.why: Cold storage fails if power cuts last long, so backup power is essential.
preset:agro_cold.step: Budget for a generator or solar backup sized for your cold rooms.

preset:agro_cold.why: Sorting and grading peak during harvest months.
preset:agro_cold.step: Ask local contractors about labour availability in peak season.

preset:agro_cold.why: Central and state schemes support cold storage and pack houses.
preset:agro_cold.step: Check the horticulture mission and agri-infrastructure fund rules.

preset:pharma.why: Medicines need a licence from the state drug regulator and good manufacturing practice certification.
preset:pharma.step: Talk to the FDA Maharashtra office about the licence process and timelines.

preset:pharma.why: Purified water and controlled clean areas are required for most products.
preset:pharma.step: Get quotes for a purified water system and clean-room build.

preset:pharma.why: Bulk drug and chemical steps need effluent treatment and MPCB consent.
preset:pharma.step: Ask MPCB which category applies and whether a common effluent plant is nearby.

preset:pharma.why: Quality control and production need science graduates and pharmacists.
preset:pharma.step: Contact nearby pharmacy and science colleges about recruitment.

preset:chemicals.why: Chemical units are usually allowed only in notified chemical zones with strict safety approvals.
preset:chemicals.step: Ask MIDC which nearby estates allow chemical units.

preset:chemicals.why: Units need treatment plants and an authorised hazardous-waste disposal site.
preset:chemicals.step: Find the nearest common hazardous-waste facility and check MPCB consent terms.

preset:chemicals.need: Raw materials by port or pipeline
preset:chemicals.why: Many chemicals arrive in bulk by ship or tanker.
preset:chemicals.step: Work out the tanker cost from JNPA or the nearest bulk supplier.

preset:chemicals.why: Fire safety approval and a nearby fire station are required.
preset:chemicals.step: Ask the local fire office about approval and response times.

preset:plastics_rubber.why: Resin and rubber prices change often, and nearby distributors cut stock costs.
preset:plastics_rubber.step: List polymer distributors within a day's drive and compare prices.

preset:plastics_rubber.why: Moulding units depend on tool rooms for making and repairing moulds.
preset:plastics_rubber.step: Find tool rooms in the district or the nearest city.

preset:plastics_rubber.why: Extended producer responsibility rules apply to plastic packaging makers.
preset:plastics_rubber.step: Check your obligations under the plastic waste management rules.

preset:plastics_rubber.why: Auto, packaging and FMCG buyers prefer suppliers close by.
preset:plastics_rubber.step: Talk to two or three buyers about delivery expectations.

preset:logistics.why: Warehouses earn their keep by being a short drive from big buyers and cities.
preset:logistics.step: Map the drive time to Mumbai, Pune and your main customers.

preset:logistics.why: Warehousing needs land zoned for it and fire safety approvals.
preset:logistics.step: Ask the planning office about zoning for warehousing on your plot.

preset:logistics.why: Some city roads restrict truck entry at certain hours.
preset:logistics.step: Check local truck entry timings on your delivery routes.

preset:logistics.need: Inland container depot or rail siding
preset:logistics.why: Container and rail links lower costs for long-distance freight.
preset:logistics.step: Find the nearest inland container depot and its rates.
